notes: Best pre-registered measured model (N084, GOAL .6911, below the .6916 improvement threshold); the GOAL record N053 = first three members (.6862; the Cytoland member re-trained with a fresh seed gives .6864). A post-hoc descriptive 6-member combination (N065) reached .6929 and is not counted. Each member = image encoder + linear heads, trained separately (10 epochs, AdamW lr 5e-4, batch 256, +-4 px random shift); test predictions are averaged. Input: one cell, 24 channels = 23 illumination patterns of an LED-array microscope (brightfield, darkfield rings at increasing angle, half-circle differential phase contrast, single LEDs) + a computed phase image, 128 x 128 px; 2x zoom = centre 64 px upsampled to 128. Self-supervised init: 2 augmented views (random scale + shift), invariance + SIGReg Gaussian regulariser, 40 epochs (ResNet-50) / 60 (draw 1) and 120 (draw 0) epochs (ConvNeXt-S) on unlabelled cells of the training split only; the SSL stem has 48 inputs (24 channels + 24 channel-present masks). Cytoland = ConvNeXtV2-T encoder of a published microscopy image-to-image model (label-free -> fluorescence), 1-channel stem repeated to 24, learned per-channel gate, encoder lr x 0.1. Targets (13 regression outputs, masked MSE over the observed ones): cells from single-stain slides have 1 protein target + 1 background (autofluorescence) target; cells from pooled-panel slides have 4 (draw 0) or 3 (draw 1) pooled targets and no background target. 11 targets are scored (GOAL = Pearson r, train on one blood draw, test on the other, mean of both directions). Aux heads: 3- and 10-class cell-type cross-entropy (weight 0.5), labels exist only for pooled-panel cells of draw 0; not used at test time. ResNet-50 members were trained on a label variant (cf150), the others on v10 labels; all scored on v10.
significance: two-sided; Holm-corrected over all comparisons of a panel (one family per panel); * <0.05 ** <0.01 *** <0.001 **** <0.0001
